rowText: Trust tier reports the lowest tier in a mixed block; over-budget blocks drop whole cards and keep the end sentinel; kb_attached is recorded after stacking so a block starved by a large Proton log reports attached=false. Needs a title that produces a large Proton log to reproduce the starvation path on-device.

setup.existing_reply_used: the completed 'what game am i playing' answer already on screen, which carries a 'Gravity Gun -- From the Half-Life wiki' card

steps.action: Tried to re-open that reply's own 'Show details' panel to read the retrieval/trust-tier line, since a fresh ask was not available (see the Ask-bar focus problem, separate finding).
steps.observed: Blocked -- expanding the turn's header worked once, but Down from inside the expanded turn then stopped moving the visible ring at the 'Show reasoning' row, on 4 separate tries. The same class of D-pad problem as the Ask-bar one, in the same chat.

plugin_log_lines: No 'trust'/'tier' text appears in the plugin's own log file -- that detail is only carried in the reply's own data and shown through Show details on screen, not written to the log.
verdictSentence: Could not read the trust-tier line tonight: the D-pad would not move down into the reply's details panel in this chat. A large Proton log to trigger the starvation path was not attempted either, since the basic walk to Show details was already blocked.
notes: Not run 2026-09-15 either (needed a title that produces a large Proton log); still a real check by the code, still owed.
